summary_full: An 11-year-old Florida student has reached the finals of a national science competition.  Her innovative soilshade balls help farmers conserve water during dry weather conditions.  This eco-friendly invention slows evaporation and keeps soil moist for extended periods.  She will compete for a $25,000 prize and mentorship from 3M scientists.  The competition celebrates young innovators using STEM to solve real-world problems.
